name: off_by_one_loop
description: Believes a for loop over i < n runs n+1 times, or that i <= n is needed to reach n.

name: loop_includes_last
description: Believes a loop that steps by one skips the last item or runs one extra time.

name: counter_vs_sum
description: Confuses the count of iterations with the accumulated total.

name: else_if_confusion
description: Believes separate if statements are mutually exclusive, or that else pairs with the first if.

name: comparison_is_assignment
description: Reads == (compare) as = (assign) in a condition.

name: int_division
description: Believes dividing two ints always gives a fractional result, or that / truncates.

name: string_concat_type
description: Confuses + on two numbers with + on a string and a number.

name: string_length_off_by_one
description: Believes length() counts one fewer or one more than the string has.

name: char_index_off_by_one
description: Believes the first character of a string has index 1.

name: array_index_off_by_one
description: Believes the first element of an array has index 1, or that index length is valid.

name: array_length_confusion
description: Believes array.length is a method or that the last index is array.length.

name: list_add_all
description: Confuses add (one element) with addAll (each element of a collection).

name: return_vs_print
description: Confuses printing a value with returning it to the caller.

name: pass_by_value
description: Believes a method can rebind the caller's variable by reassigning its argument.

name: missing_base_case
description: Forgets the base case, so a recursive method never stops.

name: missing_recursive_return
description: Forgets to return the value of the recursive call.

name: try_always_completes
description: Believes the code in a try block always finishes, or that catch runs anyway.

name: instance_vs_static
description: Confuses a static member (one per class) with an instance member (one per object).

name: object_assignment_alias
description: Believes assigning one object to another name copies the object.

name: constructor_not_returned
description: Believes a constructor must return the object it creates.

name: list_size_vs_last_index
description: Believes the last valid index of a list equals its size.

name: set_keeps_duplicates
description: Believes a set stores repeated values more than once.

name: catch_skips_rest_of_try
description: Believes statements after the one that throws still run inside the try block.

name: finally_only_on_error
description: Believes a finally block runs only when an exception was thrown.

name: object_assignment_copies
description: Believes assigning one object variable to another makes an independent copy.

name: field_shadowed_by_parameter
description: Believes a constructor parameter with the same name as a field sets the field without this.

name: set_holds_one_value
description: Believes a set can only hold a single value.

name: exception_discards_earlier_output
description: Believes output printed before the statement that throws is lost.

name: finally_replaces_try
description: Believes a finally block replaces the output of the try block.

name: initialiser_ignored
description: Believes a field's initial value is ignored and the field starts at zero.
